overview.description: The First Trust Active Factor Emerging Markets ETF (AFEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. RFEM is actively-managed to select in emerging market stocks using multiple factors. The manager has discretion to hedge currency exposure up to 100% of the portfolio. AFEM was launched on Jun 14, 2016 and is issued by First Trust.
